current_help_recovery_note: When transcript text is missing, stale, mistranscribed, or too fragmentary to answer safely, the route points back to the current official page, reviewed transcript/help lane, or named office contact instead of pretending the transcript pane is sufficient.
delivery_role_note: The service reviews official recordings and platform transcript panes so searchable/copyable transcript text remains subordinate to the official recording, any reviewed official transcript edition, and the named help lane rather than quietly becoming a shadow portable publication.
official_transcript_edition_note: Where the office publishes a reviewed transcript edition, that named edition remains the authoritative text support; platform transcript panes remain convenience surfaces unless explicitly identified as that reviewed edition.
portable_record_boundary_note: Copied or downloaded transcript text is not automatically treated as a current official portable publication unless the office separately publishes and stands behind that transcript edition.

reviewed_transcript_contexts.context_note: Reviewed platform transcript panes shown beside or beneath already-open official media.
Reviewed keyword search and transcript-line click-to-jump behavior for qualifier loss and decontextualized line reading.
Reviewed whether copied or downloadable transcript text could be mistaken for an office-issued portable transcript edition.
Reviewed whether a transcript pane derived from automatic captions/transcription stayed visibly distinct from a reviewed official transcript edition.
Reviewed whether the route still told the truth when no transcript pane or transcript search was available on the current platform/player.

search_and_jump_boundary_note: Transcript search and timestamp jumps help viewers navigate the recording but do not replace scope/date qualifiers, surrounding context, or the current help lane.
search_index_boundary_note: If transcript text affects platform or enterprise searchability, the current official written destination/help lane remains the controlling answer surface for action-changing questions.
transcript_generation_boundary_note: The service distinguishes transcript panes derived from reviewed caption files from transcript panes derived from autogenerated caption/transcription output.
transcript_surface_label: Example interactive-transcript posture for official voter-information media routes
